key_concepts: Solid materials can be changed by shaping.
Pressing can change a solid material's size and shape.
Hammering can change a solid material's shape.
Cutting can change a solid material's size and shape.
Joining pieces can change a solid material's size and shape.
Shaping, pressing, hammering, cutting, and joining may change texture.
These changes can make solid materials more useful.
Sharp tools require safe handling when cutting solid materials.
Food preparation uses cutting, shaping, pressing, hammering, and joining.
